```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
```

```{r data}
data("ny_noaa")

weather_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = as.numeric(prcp) / 10
  ) |>
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2010-01-01"),
    date < as.Date("2011-01-01")
  )
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly Average Maximum Temperature

```{r}
temp_df =
  weather_df |>
  mutate(month = lubridate::month(date)) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    avg_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_ly(
  temp_df,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~avg_tmax,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°C)")
  )
```


### Daily Minimum vs. Maximum Temperature

```{r}
scatter_df =
  weather_df |>
  filter(!is.na(tmin), !is.na(tmax)) |>
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(date),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      TRUE ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(
      season,
      levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall")
    )
  ) |>
  slice_sample(prop=0.1)

plot_ly(
  scatter_df,
  x = ~tmin,
  y = ~tmax,
  color = ~season,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  text = ~paste(
    "Date:", date,
    "<br>Station:", id,
    "<br>Min:", tmin, "°C",
    "<br>Max:", tmax, "°C"
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.5)
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum Temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.25)
  )
```


Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly Total Precipitation

```{r}
prcp_df =
  weather_df |>
  mutate(month = lubridate::month(date)) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    total_prcp = sum(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_ly(
  prcp_df,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~total_prcp,
  type = "bar"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Total precipitation (mm)")
  )
```
